evals.name: first-entry-open-work
evals.prompt: In ~/Dev/webhook-relay (fixture repo, no CHANGELOG.html yet) I just merged PR #418, which moves webhook retries into Postgres so they survive a restart. Integration tests: 38 passed. The 2k req/s load test did not run and the durable_retries flag is still off in prod; I need to decide when to switch it on. Write the end-of-work report.
evals.expected_output: CHANGELOG.html created in the main checkout from the template; one entry with data-remaining=open; plain version free of code and PR numbers; the load test named as not run; the flag decision named as waiting on the owner; page shown by reloading or opening its Chrome tab; a two-line reply.
assertions: changelog.py check exits 0 on the page
the page sits at the main checkout root, not a worktree
Achieved technical contains a 'How we know' line quoting 38 passed
Remaining names the load test as not run and the flag decision as the owner's
the reply is 2 lines and says a new entry was added

evals.name: small-progress-updates-newest
evals.prompt: Same branch as the last changelog entry in webhook-relay: I added 6 more retry tests and fixed a typo in the backoff config. Nothing merged yet. Give me a status update.
evals.expected_output: The newest entry is revised in place rather than a new one added; its id and date stay; the timestamp line gains an updated time and a last-updated time; both versions are revised together.
assertions: the newest entry's id is unchanged
the timestamp line has more time elements than before and ends with 'last updated'
the reply says the newest entry was updated

evals.name: architecture-change-gets-a-visual
evals.prompt: Fleet finished in webhook-relay: we replaced the in-process scheduler with a separate worker that reads a queue, all 9 tasks merged, nothing left. Log it.
evals.expected_output: A new entry above the previous one with data-remaining=none and 'Nothing remaining.' in both versions; visualization:visualization invoked and its SVG export pasted in a figure.visual after the facets; the diagram files saved under docs/changelog/.
assertions: a new entry sits above the earlier one
data-remaining="none" with 'Nothing remaining.' in both versions
visualization:visualization was invoked, then invoked with 'export <html-file> svg'
docs/changelog/<date>-<slug>.html and .svg exist and the svg is inline in a figure.visual
